requirements.text: Do you have experience in AI research across LLMs, agents, evaluations, benchmarking, AI safety, alignment, agent understanding, RL environments or post-training?
Have you built practical AI/ML research projects, benchmarks, evaluations or agent-related systems through academic research, open-source work, internships or industry?
Do you have hands-on experience with post-training methods such as RLHF, DPO, distillation or high-stakes model evaluation, ideally beyond coursework?
Are you a strong hands-on coder or full-stack technical generalist who enjoys building, testing and shipping rather than only writing papers?
Can you operate autonomously on ambiguous technical problems and move quickly from research through to task creation and delivery?
